description: Buick brought the Riviera into the 1980s with a convertible, the first open top version in the nameplates history and one of the few convertibles any American automaker offered at the time. This 1983 example is finished in classic white and red, with a full list of power features and a cabin that feels more like a luxury lounge than a sports car. Finished in Cotillion White with a crisp red pinstripe, this Riviera has a clean, elegant look that suits its long, formal body. A white convertible top sits neatly against the paint, and a red convertible top boot covers the folded top when its down, giving the car a polished, finished look whether youre cruising with the top up or enjoying the open air. The white and red color scheme is a classic one, and it gives the car a refined presence at any show or cruise night. Power comes from the 5.0L V8, paired with a 4 speed automatic transmission for smooth, effortless driving. Power steering and power brakes make the big Riviera easy to place on the road, and the whole drivetrain is tuned for relaxed, comfortable cruising rather than raw speed. Its an easygoing combination that suits a convertible built for sunny afternoons and scenic drives. Inside, dark red leather seating brings a rich, upscale look to the cabin, with interior wood paneling adding a warm, classic touch that fits Buicks luxury image. Power seats make it easy to find a comfortable position, and power windows, locks, and mirrors cover everyday convenience. The red leather ties in with the exterior pinstripe and top boot for a cohesive color story from end to end. This Riviera Convertible is a great chance to own a rare, open top piece of Buick history, combining classic white paint, red leather, and a comfortable V8 cruiser thats ready to enjoy with the top down. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. description: The 2016 Ford Escape Titanium takes in-cabin technology seriously, centering the experience around an advanced infotainment ecosystem. It features a premium audio setup with 10 speakers, a modern touch interface, and integrated AM/FM radio with SiriusXM as well as CD/MP3 support.  Tech-focused drivers seeking maximum connectivity and convenience will appreciate the Escape Titanium's suite of features. Its intuitive infotainment system streamlines access to navigation, music, and communications, while hands-free calling and app integration help keep attention on the road. Commuters in St. Louis and beyond benefit from features like heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a power liftgate-ideal for those who want their SUV to fit smoothly into a busy, modern lifestyle.  Performance in this SUV is enhanced by the EcoBoost 1.6L I4 GTDi DOHC Turbocharged VCT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission for responsive, fuel-efficient driving. Electronic stability control and traction control systems use sensors to adapt to changing conditions, ensuring confident handling in city traffic or on longer highway trips. The drive experience is further supported by speed-sensing steering and four-wheel independent suspension, giving drivers a sense of digital precision. With FWD and an EPA-estimated 23 city/32 highway MPG, the Escape Titanium balances responsive power with smart efficiency.  The Escape Titanium leverages a comprehensive suite of electronic safety systems, including ABS brakes, a rearview camera, and rear parking sensors that enhance situational awareness in tight spaces. The emergency communication system, 911 Assist, is designed to provide rapid response in critical moments. Dual front impact, dual front side impact, and knee airbags work in tandem with occupant sensing technology, while electronic stability control and brake assist help the SUV anticipate and react to potential hazards. This blend of sensors and automated systems delivers high-tech, smart safety in everyday driving.  Premium features on the Escape Titanium include heated leather-trimmed front bucket seats with memory, a power liftgate for hands-free cargo access, and a garage door transmitter for seamless home integration. Remote keyless entry and power-adjustable driver and passenger seats offer comfort and convenience, while the automatic temperature control ensures cabin comfort regardless of weather. The SUV's audio and infotainment systems are operated with steering wheel-mounted controls, and the rearview camera and parking sensors make maneuvering in crowded lots much easier.  Against direct competitors like the Honda CR-V EX-L and Toyota RAV4 XLE, the Escape Titanium stands out for its robust connectivity suite and advanced infotainment features. description: Thank you for stopping by our virtual showroom!  This 2024 Hyundai Elantra N Line offered in Amazon Gray will make a great addition to your family or business! Be sure to take note of all this vehicle has to offer:  Packages & Features  Option Group 01  Convenience Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road. description: This 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the most track-focused road-going 911 of the 992 generation, and this car carries the full Weissach Package. It is finished in White with Pyro Red accents, including GT3 RS side and fascia decals, and rides on forged lightweight magnesium wheels in Satin Pyro Red with yellow Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake calipers behind them. Exposed carbon fiber covers the vented front hood, roof, mirror caps, and rear wing elements, so the color pairing is classic racing livery with an unmistakably modern aero package.At its core is Porsche's 4.0-liter naturally aspirated flat-six, rated at 518 horsepower and 343 lb-ft of torque and revving to a 9,000 rpm redline. Power reaches the rear wheels through a 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) dual-clutch transmission and an electro-mechanical limited-slip differential. The GT3 RS runs from 0 to 60 mph in about 3.0 seconds and reaches a top track speed of 184 mph. The engine's sharp response and high-revving character are central to what makes this car special in an era of turbocharging.Aerodynamics define the GT3 RS. A single, centrally mounted radiator in the nose frees up space for active front aero elements. A large swan-neck rear wing with a Drag Reduction System (DRS) works with them to generate downforce far beyond any previous road-legal 911. Louvered front fender vents, side blades behind the front wheels, and a sculpted rear diffuser complete a body shaped as much by the wind tunnel as by design. The double-wishbone front suspension, adjustable damping, and rear-axle steering give the car the precision and composure to use that downforce.The interior is Black Leather and Race-Tex with Guards Red stitching, specified alongside the Weissach Package. Carbon fiber full bucket seats carry 'Weissach RS' embroidered headrests and are paired with Guards Red seat belts. The steering wheel is wrapped in Race-Tex with a yellow 12 o'clock marker. The Guards Red central tachometer, the Guards Red Sport Chrono stopwatch dial, and the Race-Tex dash and headliner make this a driver-focused environment finished to a very high
